title: Unit 19 Consolidation: Populism
goal: Review the unit on populism: the definition, Perón, Cárdenas and Vargas, the people and the leader, and the legacy.

items: I can say how populism is usually defined and why the word is disputed.
I can tell the story of Perón in the past, with events and background.
I can compare Cárdenas and Vargas using cuyo.
I can use creer que and no creer que to give the views of different historians.
I can weigh results and criticism with sin embargo, no obstante and aunque.
